deals.travelWindow: Feb 6 – Feb 2027 (Southwest one-way $79 to BWI Feb 6)
deals.whyRanked: Southwest $79 one-way to BWI seen within 24 h (RT est. ~2x; verify); DC's Mall and Rock Creek Park are 45 min by train. Still the cheapest.
deals.soloWhy: Safe, walkable core, free Smithsonian museums, and a Metro that reaches almost everything.

highlights: Smithsonian museums are free (Air and Space, American History, Natural History)
Lincoln, MLK and Jefferson memorials are best at night, lit up
Rock Creek Park trails and Georgetown C&O Canal towpath
Library of Congress reading room and Capitol tour (book ahead)
itinerary: Day 1 — Metro in, National Mall walk: Capitol, Air and Space, Washington Monument; memorials after dark
Day 2 — Morning at American History or Natural History; afternoon Georgetown and the C&O towpath
Day 3 — Rock Creek Park loop to Peirce Mill, then Union Market for lunch
guide.gettingAround: No car needed. Metro from DCA is one stop-chain to downtown (Blue/Yellow lines); buy a SmarTrip card or use phone pay.
guide.stayArea: Dupont Circle or Penn Quarter: Metro-adjacent, lively, and easy to walk home alone at night.

deals.whyRanked: Southwest $100 one-way seen within 24 h (RT est. ~2x; verify); Talbot Islands and Okefenokee-area nature within reach.
deals.soloWhy: Cheap, uncrowded beaches and parks, but you will want a car to reach them.

highlights: Fort Caroline and Kingsley Plantation in the Timucuan Preserve
Big Talbot Island's Boneyard Beach
Riverside's Five Points and the Riverwalk
Jacksonville Beach pier and boardwalk
itinerary: Day 1 — Riverside and Five Points, Riverwalk at sunset
Day 2 — Timucuan Preserve: Kingsley Plantation, Fort Caroline, then Big Talbot Boneyard Beach
Day 3 — Jacksonville Beach morning, Fernandina Beach (30 min north) if time
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car. The area is spread out and transit is thin.
guide.stayArea: Riverside/Five Points for cafes and walkability, or Jacksonville Beach for sea access.

deals.whyRanked: Southwest $100 one-way seen within 24 h (RT est. ~2x; verify); easy winter sun, Canaveral National Seashore ~1 h.
deals.soloWhy: Best as a springs-and-beaches base rather than the theme parks, and it works if you rent a car.

highlights: Wekiwa Springs: swim in 72°F spring water, paddle the run (reservations required)
Canaveral National Seashore: Playalinda beach and Turtle Mound
Winter Park: Scenic Boat Tour and Charles Hosmer Morse Museum
Lake Eola and Thornton Park downtown
itinerary: Day 1 — Winter Park walk, Scenic Boat Tour, Park Avenue lunch
Day 2 — Wekiwa Springs morning paddle, then Mills 50 district for dinner
Day 3 — Drive to Canaveral National Seashore for beach and birding
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car; downtown has SunRail but parks do not. Book the Wekiwa entry slot early on weekends.
guide.stayArea: Winter Park or Thornton Park: quieter, walkable, and near the springs.
food: Hopping on Mills 50 for Vietnamese (Hawkers for Asian street food)

deals.whyRanked: Southwest $109 one-way seen within 24 h (RT est. ~2x; verify); walkable coast and Cabrillo National Monument in town.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable neighborhoods, hostels in the Gaslamp and Pacific Beach, an easy trolley/bus network and safe daytime beach and trail options.

highlights: Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve coastal trails (Beach Trail to Razor Point)
La Jolla Cove sea lions and the La Jolla Shores kayak launch
Balboa Park gardens and free-entry museum days
Cabrillo National Monument tide pools and Point Loma views
itinerary: Day 1 — Trolley downtown, Gaslamp and Seaport Village; sunset at Sunset Cliffs
Day 2 — Torrey Pines morning hike, La Jolla Cove and Shores, tacos in Pacific Beach
Day 3 — Balboa Park, then Cabrillo National Monument tide pools before an evening flight
guide.gettingAround: Car optional for the city: the MTS Trolley and buses reach downtown, Old Town and Balboa Park; rent a car only for Torrey Pines, Anza-Borrego or Joshua Tree day trips.
guide.stayArea: Little Italy or the East Village for walkability and trolley access; Pacific Beach if you prefer a beach hostel scene.
food: Tacos at Tacos El Gordo or Salud (Barrio Logan)
Cafe Italia or Great Maple in Little Italy
Fish tacos at Oscar's Mexican Seafood (PB)

deals.whyRanked: Southwest $110 one-way seen within 24 h (RT est. ~2x; verify); quiet off-season beaches and Waccamaw NWR / Huntington Beach State Park nearby.
deals.soloWhy: Off-season is calm and cheap, with a long boardwalk and easy beach walks, though a car is needed for the best spots.

highlights: Myrtle Beach Boardwalk and SkyWheel for an easy first evening
Huntington Beach State Park: causeway alligators, birding and Atalaya Castle
Brookgreen Gardens sculpture and wildlife park
Murrells Inlet MarshWalk at sunset
itinerary: Day 1 — Boardwalk walk and pier at sunset; seafood dinner
Day 2 — Morning at Huntington Beach State Park, then Brookgreen Gardens
Day 3 — Murrells Inlet MarshWalk, then a drive to Pawleys Island before the flight
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car; the airport is about 10 minutes from the beach and attractions are spread along Highway 17.
guide.stayArea: Boardwalk area for walkability, or Murrells Inlet for a quieter marsh-side base.
